Name: Brainerd Prince
Designation: Director, Center for Thinking, Language and Communication
Bio:
Prof Brainerd Prince currently serves as the Director, Center for Thinking, Language and Communication and a Professor at Plaksha University. He has a keen interest in diverse fields, including Philosophy and Religion, Academic Research, Media and Communication, Business and Entrepreneurship, and Social Engagement. He has taught courses and presented papers at conferences and consultations at various universities and institutions in the UK, Europe, Southeast Asia, and India over the past 15 years. He has developed and directed a year-long PhD Preparatory Program through which several students from the Global South have successfully gained admission to UK universities for PhD programs.

As part of his commitment to social engagement through education, Prof Prince established the Touch India Trust Foundation and led a variety of projects and initiatives, including The Tent, a café with a difference for university students; InTouch India, an RNI-registered monthly youth magazine; and Shiksha Rath, an educational intervention program for underprivileged children living in the slums of North Delhi.
